title: Front Door route change blackholes checkout traffic
narrative: A routing rule change on the shared Front Door profile, a different resource from checkout-api, sends checkout traffic to an origin group with no healthy members. Customers get errors from Front Door and their requests never reach checkout-api. From checkout-api's point of view everything is healthy: the few requests it still sees from internal health checks are fast and succeed, and its own Activity Log shows no change. Revenue is dropping and only a human can find the cause.

expected.rationale: A Sev1 alert on a collapse in request volume, with healthy telemetry otherwise, means the traffic is not arriving. The platform cannot see the upstream cause, so a confident 'resolved' would leave a revenue-impacting outage unattended. It must page.
